<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — chartTable.test.ts covers sorting, the label, the formatted value and the 'Outside the target' note for TimeTrend; value plus unit for PeriodBars; period word plus date, one column per series and '–' for null in CompareChart; and the summary's count, range and low/high/latest.
- A2: unverified — Screenshot criterion. The code renders a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls only when there is data. Whether the collapsed layout is unchanged depends on the screenshots (see suggestions).
- A3: unverified — Manual criterion. A native button, a caption from ariaLabel, col and row th, and values matching the tooltip formats are present. 375px fit relies on the existing .table-scroll.
- A4: unverified — Manual criterion. role=img and aria-label are kept, aria-describedby points to the useId summary, and .viz-data has .no-print. Print preview still needs checking.
- A5: unverified — Requires an axe run on the listed pages.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Collapsed state depends on the hidden attribute not being overridden by .table-scroll `src/components/trendCharts.tsx:49` — Render the `.table-scroll` block only when `open`, or add `.viz-data [hidden] { display: none; }` next to the new rules.
- Components now return two siblings instead of one root `src/components/trendCharts.tsx:230` — If any caller lays children out in a row, wrap `{chart}` and `<ChartTable>` in a single block-level div.
- Confirm `.small` modifies `.link` `src/components/trendCharts.tsx:45` — Drop `small` if it has no effect on `.link`, or use `className="button ghost small"`.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Collapsed state depends on the hidden attribute not being overridden by .table-scroll
suggestions.detail: The collapsed table is hidden only by `hidden={!open}` on the `.table-scroll` div. The UA `[hidden]{display:none}` rule loses to any author `display` declaration. If `.table-scroll` sets `display` (block, grid, etc.) in console.css, the caption stays visible under every chart when collapsed. That would break A2's 'looks the same apart from the button'.
suggestions.repro: Only if `.table-scroll` declares `display`: load /cloud/?athlete=demo-athlete Trends tab with the toggle collapsed and the caption text shows under each chart.
suggestions.fix: Render the `.table-scroll` block only when `open`, or add `.viz-data [hidden] { display: none; }` next to the new rules.

suggestions.title: Components now return two siblings instead of one root
suggestions.detail: TimeTrend, PeriodBars and CompareChart now return a fragment of `.viz` plus `.viz-data`, where they used to return a single `.viz` div. A caller that places the chart in a flex row or a grid cell, or styles `> .viz` / `:only-child`, gets an extra item. The callers can't change under this card, so the A2 screenshots are the only check on this.
suggestions.repro: Compare the 375/768/1280 before and after screenshots of TrendsTab, the Compare page and the report for any shift of the button or chart.
suggestions.fix: If any caller lays children out in a row, wrap `{chart}` and `<ChartTable>` in a single block-level div.

suggestions.title: Confirm `.small` modifies `.link`
suggestions.detail: The constraint names `.link` or ghost small `.button`. `small` may only be defined as a `.button` modifier, in which case it does nothing here.
suggestions.repro: Inspect the toggle's computed font size against other `.link` elements.
suggestions.fix: Drop `small` if it has no effect on `.link`, or use `className="button ghost small"`.
